# Gabs Utilities

Gabs Utilities is a public product and tool catalog by Gabriel García Alonso,
a Berlin-based sound engineer, producer and developer-oriented creator.

## Primary pages

- Shop and theme gallery: https://gabs-utilities.com/
- Claude Code theme install guide: https://gabs-utilities.com/claude-code-theme-install-guide.html
- Semantic terminal color design article: https://gabs-utilities.com/semantic-terminal-colors.html
- Impressum: https://gabs-utilities.com/impressum.html

The semantic terminal color article explains the design choices behind the 50
free Claude Code themes, including preserved status colors, role-specific
contrast, terminal background ownership and transparent-terminal surfaces.

The install guide gives the native Claude Code plugin command, manual JSON
fallback, terminal background setup, and common troubleshooting steps:

https://gabs-utilities.com/claude-code-theme-install-guide.html

## Related public catalog

Gabriel Tools + Code keeps the broader catalog of Gabriel's public tools,
repositories and product experiments:

https://gabriel-tools-and-code.notgabriels960914.chatgpt.site
